summary: A generative ambient firmware meant to be left drifting rather than played: voices free-run on slow, semi-random timers in the harmony of Debussy and Ravel-era Impressionism.
features: Whole-tone and pentatonic scales, extended and quartal chords
Parallel 'planing' chord motion over a sustained pedal tone
No clocked sequencer or conventional keyboard voice
Six scales and eight chord types
Keybed and fourth knob not used yet; no MIDI
